parsed.rationale: The subtask requires compiling historical ticker changes for Ethereum and combined currency conversion rates. Candidate 5 (CurrencyAPI.net - Timeframe) supports retrieving historical currency conversion rates over a timeframe, which fits the need for USD to EUR and GBP from 2015-01-01 to 2021-12-31. It also supports crypto currencies, so it can provide Ethereum ticker changes. It accepts required parameters (start_date, end_date, base) that can be bound from the user request. This API is more specific to historical currency and crypto rates than generic or unrelated APIs.
